title: Turntable studies
description: A ring of framed compositions rotates through a spatial collection.
useCase: Browse a short visual collection while preserving the placement of neighbouring items.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Pale grey-blue page with cream-framed muted terracotta, teal and ochre art panels on a 3D ring, glassy serif glyphs, and round outlined arrow buttons.
motion: Arrow buttons rotate the six-panel ring 60° around its vertical axis in perspective over 0.7 s with a soft ease-out, side panels receding at an angle.
adapt: Each `panel` sits at a 60° `rotateY` step and `translateZ(220px)`; `ring` turns by `index` with a 0.7 s `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` transition under `perspective:850px`. Replace `colors` and glyphs with images, retuning 60° and 220px for other counts.
